name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 40 – Am 92
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 40b.Opposes, therefore, the increase in budgetary appropriations for militarism – including for war, weapons and military infrastructure, capacity and mobility; calls for EU budget funds earmarked for militarisation programmes to be reallocated towards supporting Member States in their efforts to improve economic and social conditions, showing due regard for the principle of economic, social and territorial cohesion and the achievement of convergence in progress;
